title: Privacy panel files an unknown host under model downloads
body: I was testing the privacy panel with a proxy that rewrites some requests and noticed a request to `evilhf.co` (not a real HF domain) was listed under "Model files (download only, nothing is uploaded)". Shouldn't anything that isn't Hugging Face be in "Other"? For a panel that's supposed to prove what leaves the device this seems important.
author: philippmossier
